role: Technical replay on already exposed normal cooking clip; no real sensor inputs and no safety validation.

3.mp4.basis: Existing manual old-video flame envelope; fixed development proxy, not abnormal-fire calibration.

conversion.selection: Largest outside fraction among confidence-eligible boxes; same box supplies confidence and area. Otherwise highest confidence below threshold, or zeros for an empty detection list.
conversion.geometry: Bounding-box area proxies, not segmented flame area or fire severity.
conversion.identity_limit: Input hashes bind these replay files; they do not prove capture timestamps or video/model provenance.

replay.warning: Sample counts are not independent event accuracy. Demo thresholds and synthetic data cannot establish fire-safety performance.

test_result: 31 dependency-free tests passed; seven dataset-tamper tests and seven visual-conversion tests plus the existing 17.
